verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents card authorization controls that enforce rules on how and where issued cards may be used. It also markets 'Spend Controls' on corporate cards and positions Spend as a way to 'control, automate' company spend. These give card-level enforced limits, but nothing in the evidence shows budgets that can be grouped by department or program. Missing for 10: department/program budget objects, explicit automatic enforcement of budget caps across cards or teams, detailed limit configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
